A Comprehensive Guide to Roboflow Trackers: Running 6 Object Tracking Algorithms from SORT to the Latest McByte via a Single API
Target Audience for This Article
Primary Audience: Engineers and PMs who have experience with object detection like YOLO but have not yet tried "tracking" across multiple frames.
Technical Level: Primarily aimed at intermediate users, among beginner/intermediate/advanced levels.
Prerequisites: Basic knowledge of Python syntax and fundamental object detection terminology such as bounding boxes and confidence scores.

What You Will Gain: You will be able to explain the differences between the six algorithms—SORT, ByteTrack, OC-SORT, BoT-SORT, C-BIoU, and McByte—and gain the decision-making criteria to select and implement a tracker that fits your video data.

This article explains the object tracking library "trackers" released by Roboflow, based solely on primary sources. Starting from the basics of why object detection and object tracking are different, we organize five classic algorithms—SORT, ByteTrack, OC-SORT, BoT-SORT, and C-BIoU—with benchmarks, and then dive into the newcomer McByte, which integrates with SAM just nine days after its release.

この記事で得られるもの：SORT・ByteTrack・OC-SORT・BoT-SORT・C-BIoU・McByteという6つのアルゴリズムの違いを説明できるようになり、自分の映像データに合うトラッカーを選定・実装するための判断材料を得られます。

Roboflowが公開する物体追跡ライブラリ「trackers」を、一次情報だけを根拠に解説します。物体検出と物体追跡がなぜ別物なのかという基本から出発し、SORT・ByteTrack・OC-SORT・BoT-SORT・C-BIoUという5つの定番アルゴリズムをベンチマーク付きで整理したうえで、公開からわずか9日というSAM連携の新顔McByteまで踏み込みます。後半ではインストールからCLI実行、検出器選びが結果に与える影響、トラッカーの選び方までを扱います。読み終える頃には、自分の映像に合うトラッカーを迷わず選べるはずです。
